name: close-copilot
description: Ask Claude about the SAP month-end close: checklist status, parked documents, open GR/IR and missing accruals, read live from SAP OData.

sap_base_url.title: SAP base URL
sap_base_url.description: Scheme, host and port only, e.g. http://sapserver:8000

company_code.title: Company code
company_code.description: Default company code for close questions

fiscal_year.title: Fiscal year
fiscal_year.description: Fixed fiscal year; leave empty to use the current one

sap_password.title: SAP password
sap_password.description: Stored in Claude Code's secure credential storage, never in settings.json

demo_mode.title: Demo mode
demo_mode.description: Use built-in sample data instead of calling SAP

config_file.title: Config file (optional)
config_file.description: JSON exported from the Chrome extension's Settings page, to reuse its data sources and thresholds
